method.method_draft: First describe the plotted axes: the horizontal axis is Study (Hr) and the vertical axis is Test Score. Observe the overall cloud of points: low study times such as 0–2 hours are paired with lower scores around 20–50, while larger study times such as 6–8 hours are mostly paired with higher scores around the upper 60s to 90s. Use the visual upward pattern of the point cloud to conclude that the variables have a positive association: as study time increases, test scores tend to increase.
